rules.name: cash-refresh-04-report-rows-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id,value_date,settlement_date,client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor,is_premium_paid,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date,netted_lots,settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob

SELECT trade_id,value_date,settlement_date,client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor,is_premium_paid,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date,netted_lots,settle_price FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant,'CFS') WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob

SELECT trade_id,value_date,settlement_date,CASE WHEN upper(trim(counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' AND (client_code IS NULL OR trim(client_code)='') THEN 'SIP' ELSE client_code END AS client_code,contract_number,derivative_type,product_code,currency,original_lots,active_lots,original_premium,mult_factor,nc_factor,fx_nc_factor,is_premium_paid,transaction_date,maturity_date,netting_status,netting_date,netted_lots,settle_price FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant,'CFS') WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob AND ((client_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(client_code)<>'' AND lower(trim(client_code))<>'null') OR (upper(trim(counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc'))
SELECT value_date,settlement_date,CASE WHEN value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob THEN 'ALIGNED' ELSE 'STOP_DATE_MISMATCH' END AS alignment FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table

SELECT value_date,settlement_date,CASE WHEN value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob THEN 'ALIGNED' ELSE 'STOP_DATE_MISMATCH' END AS alignment FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND business_unit='CFS'
SELECT trade_id,count(*) AS raw_rows FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob GROUP BY trade_id
SELECT trade_id,count(*) AS raw_rows FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant,'CFS') WHERE value_date=:valueDate AND settlement_date=:cob GROUP BY trade_id
